usedFor: Breeze holds your projects and tasks, and TRIGGERcmd runs a command on your computer through “Trigger Command”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new task is created” in Breeze, then “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd
bestTemplate.why: A new task kicks off a command on your own machine, such as a build or a backup.

watchOut: “When a new task is created” in Breeze is polling, so the command runs after a scheduled check.
